title: Wenyi Wang
text:
Welcome to my personal website. This is Wenyi Wang, a PhD student in Criminology, School of Economic, Political and Policy Sciences (EPPS), University of Texas at Dallas.
Quantitative criminologist studying how vice market legalization shapes behavioral harm, crime, and inequality among vulnerable populations.

title: Wenyi Wang
text:
Areas of Specialization

Gambling, Vice Markets, and Regulation: causal effects of gambling expansion on crime and harm; spatial analysis on exposure to gambling products and behavioral harm; translational criminology and evidence-based public policy
Quantitative Methods and Causal Inference: quasi-experimental and survey experiment for policy evaluation, Bayesian models for sparse and zero-inflated outcomes, hierarchical longitudinal modeling for longitudinal data analysis
